headline: Elderly man with Alzheimer disease survives eleven days lost in Amazon rainforest
label: NEWS
caption:
An incredible survival story from the Amazon rainforest 🌴

According to AP News and Marca, a 74 year old man with Alzheimer disease was rescued after surviving for 11 days lost in the jungle.

A park ranger revealed that the missing elderly man was found alive 10 kilometers away from where he went missing.

During his time alone in the wilderness, he managed to build a makeshift shelter using palm leaves to protect himself.

Would you be able to survive in the jungle for that long? 👇
